Class StatusViewController

java.lang.Object
library.controllers.author.StatusViewController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable, LoadsData, RequiresLoggedIn
public final class StatusViewController extends Object implements RequiresLoggedIn, javafx.fxml.Initializable, LoadsData
The StatusViewController class is responsible for managing the status and popularity of books related to the logged-in author. It loads and displays data in graphical representations such as pie charts and bar charts. This class implements the RequiresLoggedIn, Initializable, and LoadsData interfaces to ensure that it is initialized properly and can load necessary book-related data. It interacts with the Repository to retrieve book information and display it in a user-friendly manner.
